note: Per-day mean/max plus the full hourly series (schema 2, hourly retained from 2026-08-12). Forecast horizon 5 days from 2026-09-09. Sampled at 9 PIA traps (timezone Europe/Madrid) and 15 MeteoSwiss traps (timezone UTC, matching how MeteoSwiss publishes measured hours). Each station records its own 'timezone' and 'network'. 'hourlyCoverage' reports how many hours each taxon actually carries — CAMS pollen runs out before the end of the requested window, so a short day is not a calm day.
